claim: OpenAI had intentionally deleted its "Books1" and "Books2" training datasets.
evidence: Before this litigation commenced, OpenAI had deleted its “Books1” and “Books2” training datasets—datasets created from pirated books downloaded from Library Genesis (“LibGen”).
